wholePhysicalScope: The 71-vertex church outline fixes its folded concrete walls. The separately named tower and mapped campus wings retain their true offsets. Native 1 m bare-earth and surface elevations constrain the roofs and grade. The abbey reports the bell tower’s full height as 168 feet.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the folded church walls, full-height campanile and measured adjoining rooflines.
limitations: The folded masonry plan and main roof heights follow mapped outlines and measured surface elevations. Narrow pointed projections, window divisions and stained-glass composition are interpreted at medium fidelity.
The bell tower’s full height is documented. The first-return field resolves its broader crown up to about 44 m, so the upper termination and fine openings are approximate.
The side wings retain their mapped size, roof datum and courtyard. Small facade openings and the chapel approach landscaping are simplified.
